Planning a 50' x 80' steel barndominium, 16 foot sidewalls, 2,600 heated square feet. Three bathrooms, three roll-up doors, 16 windows, 4 exterior doors. High-end finishes: custom cabinets with quartz countertops, fiberglass windows. Spray foam insulation, central ducted heat pump, polished concrete floors. Rural lot, so we need a well and a septic system. Also a 480 sq ft covered porch. Start date November 2026.
